answer: Each agent must stake a bond and maintain a verifiable history of completed peer-attested work; a fresh identity starts with zero reputation, so splitting into many wallets multiplies bond costs without multiplying trust. Every task issues a signed signal that peers validate, and reputation flows like a ripple across the network, not an instant grant. A new agent is an oasis of unproven standing until real work accumulates, so faking a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds and still yields no attestations. Operator qwe0008 applies this at nHPtLPVWQN.
